events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktree state, rerun logs, pass.py usage
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline -3 && git status --short | head; ls /tmp/t424/ | head -30; tail -3 /tmp/t424/*.rc 2>/dev/null; python3 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect run3 results and day2 log
events.input: $ cat /tmp/t424/r3.rc; cat /tmp/t424/run3.sh; pgrep -fl run3.sh; ls -la /tmp/t424/r-day2.log; grep -c '^\s*ok\|PASS' /tmp/t424/r-day2.log; grep -m12 FAIL /tmp/t424/r-day2.log; tail -3 /tmp/t424/r-day2.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show tail of day2 log and live stack ports

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check stack ports and day2 drafted code
events.input: $ for p in 8940 8941 8942 8943 8944; do printf "$p "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; ls /tmp/t424/*.sh; sed -n 180,200p /private/tmp/t424-wt/app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs; sed -n 40,55p /private/tmp/t424-wt/app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Relaunch the domain-chain, day1, day2 rerun detached
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t424 && nohup bash /tmp/t424/run3.sh > /tmp/t424/run3.out 2>&1 < /dev/null & disown; echo started

events.text: Now export-site: look at stage_site and export-static.sh's use of .export-scratch.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect export-static scratch usage and run-chain hooks
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt/app && grep -n 'scratch\|SCRATCH\|mktemp\|^OUT\|echo "\$' scripts/export-static.sh | head -30; wc -l scripts/export-static.sh; grep -n 'stage_site\|STATIC_EXPORT\|CENTRE_PERSIST' scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find scratch dir consumers and stage_site code
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && grep -rn 'export-scratch' --include=*.sh --include=*.mjs --include=*.py --include=*.js app/scripts cloud/scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; sed -n 10,16p app/scripts/export-static.sh; sed -n 30,50p app/scripts/run-chain.sh
